name: Message board
description: A team's messages in time order, colored by a message's kind, channel or author or by any label, with the time range selector above the list: the view kit's Color by (thimble.colorBy) and time range (thimble.timeRange) in one small view.

records.name: message
records.one: one message posted to the board

fields.name: ts
fields.how: read in UTC, a day-first DD/MM/YYYY time as UTC

fields.name: kind
fields.how: With links when it holds a web address, else Text only

fields.name: value
fields.how: the message's kind, channel or author, or a label's value on it

accepts.means: the message on line <n>, opened in the list
